sources.name: Obchodný register SR (ORSR)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Official Ministry of Justice commercial register; search by name/IČO/seat with per-entity extracts. No API on the site itself — bulk route is via the RPO API (statistics.sk) which mirrors ORSR records.

sources.name: Register právnických osôb (RPO) open API — Štatistický úrad SR
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch — live JSON API returning full entity records (name/address history, establishment/termination dates, source register incl. Obchodný register). The canonical machine route for the Slovak company universe. Per hints: already partially harvested; extend.

sources.name: Register účtovných závierok (RÚZ) open API
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Ministry of Finance register of financial statements with full REST API: /api/uctovne-jednotky, /api/uctovne-zavierky, /api/vyrocne-spravy, incremental sync via zmenene-od. Gold source for financials of GPs, servicers, developers, portfolio companies.

sources.name: data.slovensko.sk — national open data catalog
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch (data.gov.sk now redirects here). National open data catalog hosting datasets from public registers. JS-heavy front end; dataset-level verification still needed per dataset.

sources.name: Finančná správa SR — public lists (VAT payers, tax debtors, tax reliefs)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Online + downloadable exports: VAT registrants, tax debtors, tax-reliability index, R&D/investment relief recipients. Published under CC0 / CC BY-NC-ND — genuine bulk downloads.

sources.name: DATAcube — Štatistický úrad SR statistics database
sources.verdict: Exists (page title confirmed via fetch) but the app is JS-rendered so content could not be verified this session. ŠÚ SR also documents an open API for DATAcube — verify endpoint separately.

sources.name: NBS — Register dohliadaných subjektov (subjekty.nbs.sk)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Central bank register of ALL supervised financial entities across 9 categories: banks/payment/e-money, insurance, securities market, collective investment (ManCos/AIFMs/funds), pension savings (DSS/DDS), intermediaries, CRYPTO-ASSET market (MiCA licensees), loan servicers & non-bank lenders, FX dealers. Has 'Databáza na stiahnutie' (database download). Per hints: fully harvested — extend/refresh.

sources.name: Úrad pre dohľad nad výkonom auditu (UDVA) — auditor registers
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Audit Oversight Authority publishing the register of statutory auditors and audit firms ('Zoznamy') — the fund-auditor leg of the Institutional Service Graph.

sources.name: Obchodný vestník (Commercial Bulletin)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch of the Ministry of Justice service page (old ov.justice.sk hostname no longer resolves — use this portal URL). Archive from 2004; page explicitly offers 'Sprístupnenie štruktúrovaných údajov' (structured data), matching the hint that the gazette has open data. Deed-of-record source for insolvencies, liquidations, capital changes.

sources.name: REPLIK — register of pre-insolvency, liquidation and insolvency proceedings
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch — ru.justice.sk now 302-redirects here. Searchable by name/IČO/case number: proceedings, debtors, administrators, courts, and assets for sale from bankruptcy estates (distressed-deal signal). Statistics and early-warning tools included.

sources.name: Register správcov (insolvency practitioners roll)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED to exist via fetch, but the list renders via JS (server-side fetch shows 'Žiadne výsledky'). REPLIK's administrator search is the more machine-friendly route for the same population.

sources.name: Register znalcov (court experts incl. real-estate valuers)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED to exist via fetch; JS-rendered search. This is the Slovak equivalent of a valuer directory (znalci in odbor stavebníctvo / oceňovanie nehnuteľností) — no public RICS Slovakia directory exists.

sources.name: Slov-Lex — official legislation portal (Zbierka zákonov)
sources.verdict: Exists (fetch returned minimal JS shell). Official collection of laws; useful for regulatory-change signals. Machine route not verified this session.

sources.name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) — central contract register
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch — 5.79m public contracts, RSS feed link confirmed on page, plus 'Sťahovanie údajov z CRZ' bulk download. Excellent for state-counterparty exposure of servicers, law firms, developers.

sources.name: Úrad pre verejné obstarávanie (ÚVO) — procurement office & registers
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Procurement bulletin (Vestník), list of economic operators, register of banned persons, references database, and a beneficial-owner register for bidders. Bulk open-data route not confirmed on homepage.

sources.name: Register partnerov verejného sektora (RPVS) — beneficial owners of state contractors
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Ministry of Justice register disclosing beneficial owners of companies doing business with the public sector — the one genuinely public UBO window in SK (general UBO data is access-restricted, per project law). Quick + advanced search; no public API documented.

sources.name: Burza cenných papierov v Bratislave (BSSE)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch (note: use www — bare bsse.sk has a cert mismatch). Member list, TOP members, issuer guidance, SAX index, daily trading summaries and a Novinky news section. Per hints: issuer list route confirmed.

sources.name: CDCP SR — Central Securities Depository
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Public lists: registered securities issues, issuer information, collateral rights register, monthly statistics — a second, independent issuer universe beyond BSSE.

sources.name: LEI portál CDCP

sources.name: SLOVCA — Slovak Venture Capital & Private Equity Association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fetch. Member directory split into regular/associate/partner members — the canonical GP roster for SK. Per hints: already harvested.

sources.name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA)

sources.name: SLASPO — Slovak Insurance Association

sources.name: ADSS — Association of Pension Fund Management Companies

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Institutional alternatives database; Slovakia appears mainly through pan-CEE fund vehicles, a handful of local GPs, and LP records (pension DSS/insurers) — thin, fund-level, not entity-graph deep.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: NBS supervised-entity register (fund managers/AIFMs), fund annual reports filed to Register účtovných závierok, association rosters (SLOVCA), press releases — all directly accessible to us via subjekty.nbs.sk, registeruz.sk API and slovca.sk.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Deal- and company-level PE/VC coverage of Slovakia via its global taxonomy; decent on venture rounds touching SK founders, weaker on local mid-market and NPL/credit.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Company registry filings (ORSR/RPO), press wires (TASR/SITA), startup media, firm websites. Direct routes for us: RPO API, RÚZ API, teraz.sk + SITA feeds, SLOVCA roster.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Best of the globals on the Slovak startup/VC ecosystem (works with national ecosystem reports and local partners); startup-only lens — no credit, real assets or service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Self-reported startup profiles, SIH/SBA program disclosures, startup media (Startitup, The Recursive), SLOVCA. All four are in our catalog as direct sources.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow SK coverage; self-reported profiles and funding-round news; unreliable for legal-entity ground truth.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases and self-submission; underlying verifiable layer is ORSR/RPO which we take directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: THE local benchmark: financials, risk flags, debts, insolvency and gazette monitoring for every Slovak company; widely used by banks and journalists. Not alternatives-aware (no asset-class taxonomy, no fund/LP layer).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Openly built on Register účtovných závierok (RÚZ API), ORSR/RPO, Obchodný vestník structured data, Finančná správa debtor/VAT lists, insolvency register — every one of which we catalog and can ingest directly at $0.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Credit reports and company monitoring on Slovak entities; strong on payment discipline and linkages; paid, no alternatives framing.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: ORSR/RPO, RÚZ financial statements, Obchodný vestník, court/insolvency registers (REPLIK) — direct public routes available to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Firmographics and scoring for SK within its global graph; commodity registry data resold with analytics.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: RPO/ORSR bulk data, RÚZ, gazette — all open.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Free ownership/relationship graph over Slovak registry data — proof of what pure open ORSR/RPO data yields (people-company edges).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: ORSR extracts and RPO open data exclusively — validates our deterministic-first pipeline design.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: CEE VC market maps, round roundups and investor lists including Slovakia; media/community layer rather than a database.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Self-reported VC profiles, press, SLOVCA-type rosters — signals we get from The Recursive/Startitup feeds and SLOVCA directly.

searchedButAbsent: Web search budget was exhausted for this session before the task began, so ALL verification was done by direct URL fetch (35+ fetches); nothing here was search-discovered beyond prior knowledge + hints. Confirmed absences/gaps: (1) No public RICS Slovakia member directory — valuer coverage routes through the Ministry of Justice znalec register instead. (2) No standalone Slovak factoring association found — factoring/ABL players sit under the leasing association (lizing.sk, currently serving a broken TLS cert) and NBS registers. (3) No separate national MiCA register — crypto licensees are a category inside NBS subjekty.nbs.sk (verified present). (4) No public Slovak national carbon-registry portal — SK EU ETS accounts are only browsable via the EU Union Registry public site. (5) ORSR itself exposes no API or bulk download — the machine route is the RPO API at api.statistics.sk. (6) RPVS (beneficial owners) has no documented public API. (7) energie-portal.sk, openiazoch.zoznam.sk and yimba.sk have no RSS feeds (checked pages/paths). (8) hnonline.sk, trend.sk, aktuality.sk, sita.sk, finreport.sk and the SME feed hub (rss.sme.sk, HTTP 402) block our fetcher — their RSS URLs are recorded where known but flagged unverified; retest with a browser UA before relying on them. (9) obcan.justice.sk registers (správcovia, znalci) render via JS — REPLIK is the parseable alternative for administrators. (10) AmCham member directory is login-gated. (11) investujeme.sk is dead as an independent portal (301 to Swiss Life Select) — excluded.
